{"message": "I’m here to help with a wide range of tasks! Whether you’re looking for quick facts, detailed explanations, creative writing ideas, coding assistance, travel tips, recipe suggestions, study support, brainstorming sessions, or just someone to chat with—I've got you covered.

Here’s a snapshot of some things I can do:
• **Answer questions** – from science and history to pop culture and everyday trivia.
• **Explain concepts** – break down complex topics into clear, digestible pieces.
• **Help with learning** – offer summaries, practice problems, flashcards, and study strategies.
• **Write & edit content** – draft emails, essays, reports, stories, poems, scripts, social‑media posts, and more.
• **Generate code snippets** – assist with debugging, explain algorithms, write small programs, or walk through larger projects.
• **Plan trips** – suggest itineraries, packing lists, local attractions, and cultural etiquette.
• **Cook up recipes** – give ingredient substitutions, meal plans, dietary tweaks, and cooking techniques.
• **Brainstorm ideas** – brainstorm names, slogans, marketing angles, event themes, gifts, etc.
• **Provide mental wellness prompts** – share mindfulness exercises, gratitude practices, journaling prompts (while respecting privacy).
• **Translate text** between many languages.
• **Simulate conversations** for role‑playing scenarios like interviews, negotiations, tutoring, therapy simulations, etc.
• **Offer general life advice** – time management, goal setting, productivity hacks, budgeting basics.
• **Assist with research** – locate sources, summarize articles, compare viewpoints.
• **Create quizzes & games** – design trivia sets, word puzzles, logic challenges.
• **Support hobbyists** – guide woodworking, gardening, photography, music theory, gaming strategy, DIY crafts.
• **And much more** – feel free to ask about anything else you think might benefit from AI assistance!

Just let me know what you’d like to work on next."}
